title: Peppery Crumble Chicken
description: A delicious and flavorful chicken dish with a crispy crumble topping, served with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together horseradish sauce and olive oil.
Add the chicken to the bowl and mix until coated.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is baking, mix the peppery cheese crumble in a bowl.
Remove the chicken from the oven and sprinkle the crumble mixture on top.
Return the chicken to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
